entries.what: Thao's Monday night shift on 4 West runs 7 p.m. to 7:30 a.m.; she parks in the gravel overflow lot and takes the shuttle up Ortega Hill. Before leaving she spends her afternoon wake-up time comparing burr grinders for Linh's December birthday.
entries.outcome: Narrowed grinders to two under $150 based on grind consistency specs.

entries.what: Overnight on 4 West she eats leftover rice at 2 a.m. and works with Jasmine and Rubén through a busy but steady night.
After Monday night's shift she gets home around 8 and sleeps behind blackout curtains with the box fan; Veterans Day means a quiet building and Tomás home from his apprentice job.
Thao works Tuesday night on 4 West, with a thermos of cà phê sữa đá made at home before she leaves.
Home from the night shift and asleep by 8:30, she wakes mid-afternoon and signs up online to sort cans at the Our Lady of the Marsh food drive on Nov 22.
Her slow passenger tire is worse, so she has the assistant script exactly what to say before calling the tire shop, then asks whether they take online booking.
entries.outcome: Prepared the script and looked for an online booking option instead of calling.

entries.what: Evening at home with Tomás, who leaves a chili pot soaking; the 209 wall is loud so she puts in earplugs and white noise before sleeping a bit more.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening, a little rest before the weekend shifts.

entries.what: The first fall storm hits, with heavy rain flooding Ruel Road and delaying commuters; Thao skips her pre-shift boardwalk walk because the marsh trail is flooded.
Thursday is a day off; she does laundry with her card at the Marisol Gardens laundry room and makes a dinner of eggs and rice while rain pounds the balcony pothos.
Her mother Hạnh leaves a voicemail in Vietnamese at 1 p.m., mid-sleep, and Thao replies by text later.
Driving to her Friday night shift in the storm's tail, Thao gets a flat on Ruel Road and follows a step-by-step tire-change list on her phone, with no panic.
entries.outcome: Changed to the spare and got to work on time.

entries.what: She has two new front tires put on at the shop, paying for the storm flat damage.
entries.outcome: Car now has two new front tires.

entries.what: Friday night on 4 West is busy with post-storm cases, and she works the full 7 p.m. to 7:30 a.m. shift.
Thao gets home at 8 a.m. after Friday night and sleeps until mid-afternoon with the box fan on.
Saturday afternoon she goes to Ruiz Family Market for fish sauce and produce and cooks a quick dinner.
She texts Linh to ask how studying is going and offers to bring food, keeping the grinder gift secret.
entries.outcome: Linh says she's fine; Thao stays alert.

entries.what: Sunday morning she sleeps in, then drinks coffee on the balcony and checks on the pothos and basil.
Sunday dinner at Hạnh's Pell Road house with Linh, where Hạnh asks about Linh's classes and Thao steers the conversation.
Back home she packs scrubs and rice for Monday night and goes to bed early.
